comment: G5 (roadmap 2026-07-18): CJK/mixed-script corpus for the cjk_mixed denoise suite. Ids 90200+ (multiscript guard owns 90101-90108, main corpus owns 1-200). Five target/hard-negative pairs + 15 background docs. The background docs deliberately reuse common CJK dev vocabulary (修复/问题/配置/数据库/日志/…) so target-term IDF does not collapse — a tiny all-target corpus makes every query term rare and hides ranking regressions (2026-07-17 audit lesson). G15 adds 90211-90216: ENGLISH-ONLY docs in hard-negative pairs (90211/90212 clamp, 90213/90214 enrich, 90215/90216 probe) for the cjk_xlang face — Chinese query must reach an English doc through the synonym bridge.
